optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Reliability Data Scientist, Theme Park Rides

professionalSummary.text: The candidate has experience building failure-prediction models from sensor and maintenance data.
professionalSummary.witness: Data Scientist, Glenmoor Leisure Parks (June 2023 to September 2026): built survival models for wheel-assembly and brake-fin failures on two roller coasters from vibration readings and the work-order history, and flagged assets for inspection when the predicted risk passed the agreed limit.

experienceHighlights.text: The candidate maintains an asset-health dashboard for engineering managers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the asset-health dashboard in Power BI for the engineering managers of both parks, refreshed nightly from the maintenance management system.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: The candidate runs failure-mode and effects analyses with maintenance planners.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Facilitated failure-mode and effects analysis workshops with the maintenance planners for the water-ride pumps and recorded the agreed severity, occurrence and detection ratings.

skills.text: The candidate prepares reliability statistics such as mean time between failures for external reviews.
skills.witness: Calculated mean time between failures by ride and component for the 2025 review with the parks' insurer and wrote up the calculation method in an appendix.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building failure-prediction models, maintaining an asset-health dashboard, running failure-mode analyses, and preparing reliability statistics. They do not establish the candidate's possession of a recognized reliability certification.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's qualifications are partially supported by the provided evidence, and further human review is required to assess the candidate's suitability for the role.
